theorems.name: Submission.bv_abs_variation_smoothed_abs
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (w : Rn n → ℝ) (η : ℝ), 0 < η → ContDiff ℝ 1 w → ContDiff ℝ 1 (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (w x ^ 2 + η ^ 2) - η) ∧ (∀ x, ‖fderiv ℝ (fun x ↦ Real.sqrt (w x ^ 2 + η ^ 2) - η) x‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ w x‖) ∧ ∀ x, abs (Real.sqrt (w x ^ 2 + η ^ 2) - η - |w x|) ≤ η
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
